text: oh is it the floor i have on the 3rd level
resolution: Answered + fixed: two different floors. The floor you FELL THROUGH was your 3rd-level BUILD floor (a piece) — my first collider fix only rebuilt floor collision from the painted-ground rows (which come after the piece rows), so the built floor plate got no collider. The 4096-rect CAP is the painted GROUND, not your build — my second fix derived collision from every instance row, which turned every painted cell into a collision box and blew the cap. Final fix decouples them: painted ground travels as one heightfield per chunk (cheap, like /test), and built floor plates get an instance-derived walkable rect (rows < piece_count) on top of their baked collider so they stay solid. Same change set as req_0446 (worldColliders.ts / packageMap.ts / world_loader.zig). Verified TS 4/4 + ast-check; needs rebuild + re-Compile in-game. Nothing committed.
